overall: The AG found the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to announce, at its next meeting, the result of its April 13 executive session minutes review; release of the minutes did not excuse that failure.

allegations.summary: Board reviewed September 15, 2025 executive session minutes on April 13 but did not announce the result of that review at its next meeting on April 14.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law when it failed to announce at its next meeting the result of its April 13 review of minutes of an executive session held on September 15, 2025.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
remedy_passage: We order the Board's immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
